description: This file defines the SettingsActivity class, which is a PreferenceActivity allowing users to modify network usage settings via a preferences UI. It manages registration of preference change listeners and updates a static variable in NetworkActivity upon preference changes.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: An Android PreferenceActivity that handles user settings for network usage, managing preference change listeners and updating UI refresh status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and loads preferences from XML.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers preference change listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters preference change listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles preference changes and triggers display refresh in main activity.
